messages:
mara: Heads-up — seeing a flapping handshake for a subset of tenants. Console shows them pinned to v1 but router occasionally sends to v2. Noticed quota/usage spikes.
sam: I saw that too this morning. 3 tenants, all missing X-Redwood-Client-Version header. Might be header-coalescing when going through our proxy.
eli: Logs? any consistent pattern (seq len, content-type)?
mara: Quick log sample:
```
[router] route_decision tenant=t123 client_version=unknown pinned_version=v1 final_routed=v2 reason=compat_fallback
headers: {Host: api.redwood, X-Redwood-Session: abc, X-Forwarded-For: 10.0.0.1}
```
sam: yeah looks like handshake fallback kicks in because header absent, but console still shows pin -> confusing UX for customers.
router-bot: alert: route_mismatch_detected tenant=t123 count=42 window=10m :eyes:
jon: Console idea: surface a "last_routed_version" for each route and a small badge that explains why routing diverged. Also expose a per-route "force-pin" toggle that will enforce routing locally (with warning about capacity).
mara: There's a cost implication too — v2 token accounting differs and we've hit unexpected billing spikes on affected tenants. Need a soft-mitigation while we fix header stripping.
sam: Proposed safe-coexistence playbook (sketch):
1) Show last_routed_version + timestamp in console.
2) Add a per-route "force_pin_until" with a TTL (console-level override).
3) Implement a temporary quota-smoothing policy: when routed_version != pinned_version, cap billing delta to X% and emit anomaly event.
4) Router: prefer pinned_version unless compatible probe says otherwise (probing frequency 1/1000 requests).
eli: Telemetry needs: event=version_routing {client_version, routed_version, pinned_version, quota_delta, tenant_id, sample_rate}
mara: Example config snippet for 2/3 above:
```
{
  "route_overrides": {
    "t123": {"force_pin_until": "2024-02-10T15:00:00Z", "reason": "customer_request"}
  },
  "quota_smoothing": {"enabled": true, "max_delta_pct": 15}
}
```
tara: telemetry schema ok from data-platform POV, prefer snake_case and include sampler: {"sample_rate": 0.1}. We'll add a dashboard tile if you emit the event.
jon: UX: show a small inline hint when console toggle used: "force pin may increase latency / decrease capacity — contact SRE for exceptions". Also link to runbook.
mara: Action items: mara will add quick probe instrumentation for header presence and emit version_routing events (ETA today EOD); sam will add backend for force_pin and quota_smoothing (ETA tomorrow); eli will add console affordance copy + badge mock; tara will wire dashboard and sampling. I'll open a small RFC PR with config and runbook after probes land.
sam: Note: we should also add a short-term mitigation on edge proxy to preserve X-Redwood-Client-Version header — ops ticket filed #OPS-438.
jon: :thumbsup: prefer to get the console hint + runbook before we flip any tenant-level pins.
mara: Thanks — will post updates here as probes run. If anyone sees more flips please ping with tenant ids and request-id.
